Generation 1 Transformers palettes

Source: R/palettes.R
tf_palettes.Rd

A named list of colour palettes covering Optimus Prime, Megatron, and every member and combined form of the core Generation 1 combiner teams. Each character has a palette for the original toy, most also have one for the Sunbow cartoon, and some have one for the Marvel comic; see the medium column of tf_characters. Each element is a character vector of four to six hex colours ordered so that the first few are the most distinct from one another (body colour first, then secondary colour, then accents). Use tf_palette() to pull colours from a palette, tf_team_palette() to take one colour from each member of a combiner team, and tf_characters for background on each character.

Usage

tf_palettes

Format

A named list of character vectors of hex colours.

Details

Toy palettes are named after the character (optimus_prime); cartoon and comic palettes carry a suffix (optimus_prime_cartoon, optimus_prime_comic). Hex values are approximations: toy colours were curated by eye from product photography on the Transformers Wiki (https://tfwiki.net/) and the toys' published colour descriptions, cartoon colours from the animation models as they appear in episode stills, and comic colours from the character's early Marvel appearances. Chrome and die-cast parts do not reduce to a single flat colour; those entries reflect how the part photographs.

See also

tf_palette(), tf_palette_names(), tf_media(), tf_teams(), tf_characters, tf_show_palettes()

Examples

length(tf_palettes)
#> [1] 118
tf_palettes$optimus_prime
#> [1] "#D0202A" "#1F3E8F" "#B8BABF" "#F2D23C" "#2D2D2D"
tf_palettes$optimus_prime_cartoon
#> [1] "#D9262C" "#2244A0" "#A9AEB3" "#8FCBE8" "#4A4F55"
tf_palettes$devastator
#> [1] "#3FA23F" "#6E3FA3" "#B5B8BD" "#262626" "#E9C23B"
